Create a photorealistic editorial photograph set in a temporary bookbinding studio inside a decommissioned mountaintop cable-car signal cabin during a sleet storm. An unmistakably adult woman sits at a scarred workbench; her visible adult face, hair length, hair color, hair texture, hair part, general complexion, and facial features follow the supplied appearance reference. She hand-sews a palm-sized accordion weather diary: her left hand pins the folded indigo paper signatures against a wooden sewing cradle while her right hand pulls waxed crimson linen thread through a punched sewing station, leaving a clearly visible tightening stitch. A lit green-shaded brass desk lamp is visibly present beside the tools. Through the cabin's broad window, diagonal sleet and cloud-swallowed cable towers are plainly visible. Include a bone folder, awl, thread spool, damp gloves, obsolete cable gauges, and a small brass barometer as believable working evidence. Emphasize precise hand-to-tool contact, a readable craft sequence, the contrast between delicate binding work and severe alpine weather, tactile paper fibers, wet glass, and grounded photographic realism.
